mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.owner_id, f.content, f.follow_type, f.next_follow_at, f.created_by, f.created_at, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS created_by_name FROM customer_follow f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.created_by WHERE f.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT f.id, f.owner_id, f.content, f.follow_type, f.next_follow_at, f.created_by, f.created_at, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS created_by_name FROM customer_follow f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.created_by WHERE f.id = #{id}
